delivery: One finding per commit; one final push to codex/composition-ce12.

fixes.finding: Separated vector tracks lose timing findings
fixes.implementation: Reuse evaluator component reads; combine separated axes into one moving property.
fixes.regressions: Joint/separated position, anchor and scale have identical evaluated paint and timing findings; vector components do not double the property count; expression overrides remain excluded.
fixes.setupCorrection: Initial anchor control was outside the viewport; place all controls on screen before asserting timing.

fixes.finding: Velocity probes bypass the shared lint budget
fixes.implementation: One budgeted sample callback charges retained integer frames, shared fractional searches, fractional middle samples and all velocity probes to the unchanged 2,000,000 limit.
fixes.regressions: Probe-only exhaustion, below-limit combined sampling, fractional search-plus-probe exhaustion and unchanged shared-clock evaluation count.

fixes.finding: Staggered motion gets a false co-start warning
fixes.implementation: Derive onset from the first changed final property sample; use the previous adjacent frame only when it does not cross a declared cut. Visibility gaps start at the current sample.
fixes.regressions: Forward stagger excludes false co-start, zero-stagger controls retain genuine starts, delayed expressions find the correct onset, visible lifetime starts stay correct, and shot/explicit-cut onset stays in the new shot.

red.result: 2 expected failures and 11 passes on valid stagger controls before repair; 2 expected boundary failures and 13 passes during final review

green.result: All 1,663 unit tests and 16 CLI tests pass on final source.

fixes.setupCorrection: A zero-offset stagger is invalid; synchronized control omits the stagger behaviour.
fixes.reviewRepair: Spec re-review found onset backdating across a cut; added explicit-cut and shot tests and repaired it before the third commit.
